description: HPC topic taxonomy for measuring training-data coverage. Areas -> leaves; every leaf has Python regex patterns (case-insensitive; (?-i:...) = case-sensitive) used by coverage.py.

matching_rules.document: A document maps to a leaf if any leaf pattern matches its URL or title, or if the leaf's patterns match >= MIN_BODY_HITS (3) times in its extracted text (first 200,000 chars). Multi-label.
matching_rules.qa: A Q&A row maps to a leaf if any leaf pattern matches its question text (user turn) or its source URL. Multi-label.
matching_rules.status: GAP: < 10 documents or < 30 est. 1,500-char chunks; THIN: < 40 documents or < 150 chunks; otherwise OK (thresholds in coverage.py).
